## Chapter One

[P01] Mr. Jones, of the Manor Farm, had locked the hen-houses for the night, but was too drunk to remember the pop-holes. With the ring of light from his lantern dancing from side to side, he lurched（踉跄着走） across the yard, kicked off his boots at the back door, drew himself a last glass of beer from the barrel（桶）, and made his way up to bed, where Mrs. Jones was already snoring.

[P02] As soon as the light in the bedroom went out, there was a stirring（搅动） and a fluttering（飘动） all through the farm buildings. Word had gone round that old Major, the prize Middle White boar（公猪）, had had a strange dream and wished to tell the other animals about it. They had agreed to meet in the big barn（谷仓） as soon as Mr. Jones was safely out of the way. Old Major, also called Willingdon Beauty, was so highly regarded on the farm that everyone was quite ready to lose an hour's sleep to hear what he had to say.

[P03] At one end of the big barn, on a raised platform（舞台）, Major was already in his bed of straw（稻草）, under a lantern hanging from a beam. He was twelve years old and had grown rather fat lately, but he was still a majestic（威严的）-looking pig, with a wise and kind appearance even though his tushes（獠牙） had never been cut. Soon, as the other animals began to arrive, he lay down comfortably on his side.

[P04] First came the three dogs, Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher, then the pigs, who settled in the straw before the platform. The hens perched on the window-sills, the pigeons fluttered（飘动） up to the rafters（椽子）, the sheep and cows lay behind the pigs and began to chew（咀嚼）. The two cart-horses, Boxer and Clover, came in together, walking slowly and setting down their big hairy hoof（蹄） with care in case some small animal hid in the straw. Clover was a stout（肥胖的） motherly mare（母马） near middle life, who never got her figure back after her fourth foal（马驹）. Boxer was huge, not much intelligence, but everyone respected him for his steady（平稳） character and tremendous（极大的） powers of work. After the horses came Muriel, the white goat, and Benjamin, the donkey. Benjamin was the oldest animal, and the worst tempered. He seldom talked, and when he did, it was usually to make some cynical（冷嘲的） remark（评论）. Last came the cat, who looked round for the warmest place.

[P05] When all had assembled（集合）, Major cleared his throat and began: "Now, comrades（同志们）, what is the nature of this life of ours? Let us face it: our lives are miserable, laborious（辛苦）, and short. We are born, we are given just so much food as will keep the breath in our bodies, and those of us who can are forced to work to the last atom（原子） of our strength... No animal in England knows the meaning of happiness or leisure（闲暇） after he is a year old. No animal in England is free. The life of an animal is misery and slavery: that is the plain truth."

[P06] "But is this simply part of nature's order? Is it because our land is so poor that it cannot give a decent（像样） life to those who live on it? No, comrades, a thousand times no! The soil of England is fertile（肥沃）... it could feed far more than the present inhabitants（居民）. Our farm could support a dozen horses... it produces food enough for five. Why then do we continue in this miserable（悲惨的） condition? Because nearly all the produce of our labour（劳作） is stolen from us by human beings. There, comrades, is the answer to all our problems. It is summed（总结） up in a single word—Man. Man is the only creature（生物） that eats without producing. He does not give milk, he does not lay eggs, he is too weak to pull the plough, he cannot run fast enough to catch rabbits. Yet he is lord（老爷） of all the animals. He sets them to work, he gives back only the bare（仅够） minimum（最低） to keep them from starving（挨饿）, and the rest he keeps for himself. Our labour（劳作） tills the soil, our dung（粪便） fertilises（施肥） it, and yet not one of us owns more than his bare skin（皮肤）. You cows... how many thousands of gallons（加仑） of milk have you given this year? And what has happened to that milk?... And the hens... how many eggs?... And you, Clover, where are those four foals（小马） you bore?... No animal escapes the cruel knife in the end."

[P07] "That, comrades, is the answer to all our problems. It is all in one word—Man. Take Man away, and the cause of hunger and too much work is gone for ever."

[P08] "And remember, comrades, your resolution... I do not know when that Rebellion（造反） will come, in a week or in a hundred years... but I know, as surely as I see this straw under my feet, that late（迟早） justice will be done. Fix your eyes on that, comrades... And among us animals let there be perfect unity（团结）, perfect comradeship（友谊） in the struggle（斗争）. All men are enemies. All animals are comrades."

[P09] "Whatever goes upon two legs is an enemy. Whatever goes upon four legs, or has wings, is a friend. And remember also that in fighting against Man, we must not become like him. Even when you have beaten him, do not take his bad ways. No animal must ever live in a house, or sleep in a bed, or wear clothes, or drink alcohol（酒精）, or smoke tobacco（烟草）, or touch money, or do trade. All the habits of Man are evil. And, above all, no animal must ever be a tyrant（暴君） over his own kind... All animals are equal."

[P10] "And now, comrades, I will tell you about my dream of last night... it was a dream of the earth as it will be when Man has vanished（消失）... But I have told you my dream... I have little time left... I must pass it on to you."

[P11] Major said that as a young pig his mother and the other sows（母猪） sang an old tune, Beasts（野兽） of England, and he knows only the tune and three words... "It is time that I passed it on to you."

[P12] Old Major cleared his throat and sang: "Beasts of England, beasts of Ireland, beasts of every land and clime（地方）, hearken（倾听） to my joyful tidings（消息） of the golden future time." The animals took it up and sang five times in a row（连续）; in the excitement, seven times.

[P13] The singing stirred（搅动） the farm: the cows lowed, the dogs barked... Jones woke up... "the whole farm was in an uproar"?

[P14] Jones seized his gun and fired number 6 shot into the darkness. The pellets（颗粒） hit the barn wall and the meeting broke up. Everyone fled to his own sleeping-place. The birds jumped on to their perches, the animals settled in the straw, and the whole farm was asleep in a moment.
